text: 11月2日，香港证券及期货事务监察委员会（以下简称香港证监会）公布其首份《大型机构人工智能应用及准备情况调查》，结果显示机构已将人工智能（AI）广泛应用于业务及监控职能，但指出以负责任的方式扩展应用规模正面对挑战。本次调查于2026年7月至8月进行，涵盖20家大型金融机构及其78家香港联属持牌法团，覆盖今年上半年证券市场交易的75%。调查发现，全部受访机构均已运用AI；95%预期未来一年会加快AI应用；90%受访机构反映已运用或评估AI防范网络攻击风险；55%机构正运用或正在试用代理式AI。(中国基金报)
text_en: On November 2, the Securities and Futures Commission of Hong Kong (HK SFC) published its first "Survey on the Use and Preparedness of Artificial Intelligence by Large Institutions," which found that institutions have widely adopted artificial intelligence (AI) across business and monitoring functions, but noted challenges in scaling adoption responsibly. The survey, conducted from July to August 2026, covered 20 large financial institutions and their 78 affiliated licensed corporations in Hong Kong, accounting for 75% of securities market trading in the first half of this year. It found that all surveyed institutions had adopted AI; 95% expected to accelerate AI adoption over the next year; 90% reported having used or evaluated AI to guard against cyberattack risks; and 55% were using or trialing agentic AI. (China Fund News)
